question: Let $A = \begin{pmatrix}0 & 2 \\ 2 & 0 \end{pmatrix}$ and $B = \begin{pmatrix}1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 \end{pmatrix}$. Compute $A^2$, $B^2$, $AB$, $BA$, and verify whether $AB = BA$ and if $A$ and $B$ commute under multiplication.

options.D: $A^2=4I$, $B^2=I$, $AB=\begin{pmatrix}0&-2\\2&0\end{pmatrix}$, $BA=\begin{pmatrix}0&2\\-2&0\end{pmatrix}$, so $AB\ne BA$ and $A,B$ do not commute
